name: @projexlight/sdk-storm
summary: Storm + mass-event coordinator: ingests external weather/outage feeds, materializes per-region intensity cells, and spawns a structured fan-out of dispatchable tasks. Decouples 'a hurricane is coming' from 'these 4,000 customers need triage in this order' so sdk-dispatch + sdk-assignment can absorb the wave without code changes per event.

events.name: storm.event.declared.v1
events.description: Operator (or auto-trigger) declared a mass event; carries id, kind, geo extent, severity.

events.name: storm.event.spawned.v1
events.description: Mass-event materialized: intensity cells generated + downstream consumers (sdk-dispatch) can fan out.

events.name: storm.event.closed.v1
events.description: Event resolved; downstream queues released from elevated SLAs.

events.name: storm.intensity.updated.v1
events.description: Per-cell intensity refreshed from upstream feed; sdk-dispatch can repriorize.

models.description: Per-event row: kind (hurricane/wildfire/outage/snow), severity tier, geo extent (GeoJSON polygon), declared_at, expected_closed_at.
Per-cell row: event_id, geo cell (H3 hex or quadkey), intensity (0..1), updated_at.

hooks.name: declareEvent
hooks.description: Operator (or auto-trigger from a feed) declares a mass event. Emits .declared.v1 + warm sdk-dispatch's queue capacity.

hooks.name: ingestFeed
hooks.description: Pull from an upstream weather/outage feed; refresh intensity cells. Idempotent on (feed, observation_time).

hooks.name: spawnDispatchTasks
hooks.description: For each affected customer in the event's geo, queue a task via sdk-dispatch. Emits .spawned.v1 with the batch summary.

hooks.name: closeEvent
hooks.description: Mark event resolved; downstream SLAs drop back to normal.

hooks.name: startFeedPoller
hooks.description: Background worker — polls configured feeds + refreshes intensity. Safe to leave running in dev.

scenarios.title: Operator declares Cat-3 hurricane → 4,000 tasks queued
scenarios.when_to_use: NHC issues a hurricane warning for the tenant's service area; operator declares the event + spawns the task batch.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Event row written + .declared.v1 emitted. spawnDispatchTasks adds 4,000 rows to dispatch.queue + .spawned.v1 carries the batch count. sdk-dispatch + sdk-assignment absorb the wave.

scenarios.title: Power-grid outage feed auto-declares when threshold crossed
scenarios.when_to_use: Power-grid status feed indicates outage affecting 500+ accounts. Auto-declarer fires below the operator notice — emits .declared.v1 + alerts oncall.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Event auto-declared, oncall alerted (PagerDuty / Slack via sdk-notification). Operator confirms + calls spawnDispatchTasks. Auto-trigger event itself audited in .declared.v1.

scenarios.title: Intensity refresh repriorizes a region
scenarios.when_to_use: Storm intensifies overnight; cells in the eyewall path jump to intensity=0.9. Refresh emits .intensity.updated.v1 which sdk-dispatch reacts to (re-prioritize queued tasks).
scenarios.expected_outcome: Cells updated atomically; .intensity.updated.v1 fires per affected (event, cell). sdk-dispatch can pull + re-materialize routes in the new priority order.

scenarios.title: Operator closes the event after restoration finishes
scenarios.when_to_use: Last triage task done; operator closes the event. Downstream SLAs drop back to normal; subsequent intake is regular priority.
scenarios.example_code:
import { closeEvent } from '@projexlight/sdk-storm';
await closeEvent({ event_id, closed_by_persona_id, post_mortem_url });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Event closed; .closed.v1 emitted. Subsequent customer requests are queued at standard SLAs. Audit trail retains the full declare → spawn → intensity → close timeline.

scenarios.title: Reactive — back off spawning if dispatch queue saturated
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on dispatch.task.completed.v1 — track completion rate; if completion rate < spawn rate by 10x for >30 min, throttle spawn to avoid queue meltdown.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Spawn rate halved temporarily; operator paged with the saturation alert. When completion rate recovers, throttle auto-lifts.

compliance_posture.notes: All declarations + closes pinned to operator persona for after-incident review (NERC-CIP). Intensity refresh log is the audit trail for 'why did we re-prioritize this customer at 02:34?'. Auto-declare threshold pinned per tenant + reviewed quarterly to avoid declaration fatigue.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per task spawned into dispatch (volume discount on mass events)
